content: xneur (X Neural Switcher, Linux X11, packaged Debian/Ubuntu/FreeBSD): auto mode detects language of word being typed, switches layout and converts in place on the fly; manual mode corrects on hotkey; also fixes common typos in two languages; Gxneur GTK frontend. Dead on modern GNOME Wayland (X11-only, tray indicator broken). Confirms the auto-vs-manual dichotomy and shows typo-fixing scope creep.
